info.name: DeckCraft integration
info.summary: Edit PowerPoint presentations in Nextcloud with DeckCraft
info.description:
Open a PowerPoint (.pptx, .potx, .ppsx) or DeckCraft presentation in Files with **Edit in DeckCraft** and work on it right in the browser: themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, transitions, animations, speaker notes and the slide show.
- **Save** stores the presentation in DeckCraft's own format next to the original the first time (you pick the name and folder), and to that file from then on. **File › Export › PowerPoint** writes the .pptx back, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version. - **Export** (PDF, PNG, JPEG, outline) stores a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking a presentation in Files opens it in DeckCraft.
DeckCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [DeckCraft](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native presentation app. It embeds a build of DeckCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
